mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) from the prior month signal a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A supply contraction regime, defined by a 0.5% or greater decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months, signals reduced manufacturing output and higher input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during supply contraction regimes, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, indicating an impending recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals a weak supply chain and reduced manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls growth rate below 0.5% signals a slowing labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
